XECH Air Storm II Portable Table Fan

Rechargeable Telescopic Fan

Stay cool, stay classy with the XECH Air Storm II! Compact, foldable, and rechargeable, it’s designed to help you stay cool. With 3 adjustable speeds, a telescopic height of up to 80cm, and whisper-quiet operation, this mini foldable fan brings you cool, customized comfort wherever you need it. Perfect for power cuts, compact desks & travelling. Beat the heat anywhere with the  a sleek and powerful cooling solution designed for modern lifestyles. Combining contemporary styling with efficient performance, this portable fan delivers a refreshing breeze while maintaining whisper-quiet operation. Its compact, lightweight build makes it perfect for use on desks, bedside tables, kitchen counters, or even while travelling.

The Air Storm II is engineered with a high-speed motor and aerodynamic blades that ensure strong yet smooth airflow, ideal for keeping you comfortable during work, study, or relaxation. With multiple speed settings, adjustable tilt, and energy-efficient performance, this table fan puts you in full control of your comfort. Its sturdy base and modern design blend seamlessly with any décor, making it both a functional and stylish addition to your space. Whether at home, in the office, or on the go, the is your perfect personal cooling companion.
